correctness.rationale: Four-state labeled de Bruijn graph gives exact cyclic predecessor equivalence, 41 reachable Boolean relations and integer transition dynamics. The 41 recurrence-error zeros, with Cayley-Hamilton, prove the sixth-order recurrence for every n>=1; six base cases identify the cubic power-sum and period-three closed form. Direct exhaustive ring images through n=13 and 70 recurrence entries corroborate. Asymptotics follow from the unique dominant cubic root.

value.rationale: This is a natural all-length image problem for the canonical left-permutative Rule 30. It exhibits an exactly quantified exponential rate of non-surjectivity for finite spatial periods despite infinite full-shift onto behavior, going beyond existing small numeric image tables. Structural transfer-monoid proof generalizes conceptually to other elementary rules; theorem has explicit natural object and invariant.
